race.comment: ATEYATE (1) sets the standard after a solid fifth at Donald over 2200m, beaten just under three lengths, and has shown he can place at this distance. The quick back-up with a 1.5kg claim and blinkers on means he can give this a shake. CHAPPA (4) also has upside after his Port Lincoln sixth, just over three lengths from the winner, marking a positive step. Tackling 1800m for the first time but in the mix on best. ST DOMINIC (6) deserves attention third-up after being held up near 200m when fourth at Balaklava. Dropping from provincial company, he has enough recent form to contest for a place. QUEEN MILEYVA (7) was slow away and held first-up at Warrnambool, but she's lightly raced and now has a 2kg claim. The new 1800m should bring improvement. Include.
